Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling northbound in the left-turn lane at an intersection in Katy, Texas, and was turning left when the
vehicle was struck on the driver side by Driver 2, who was proceeding straight through the intersection. Driver 1
reported pain in the left shoulder at the scene and was transported for evaluation. The Passenger, seated in the front
right seat, was also present in the vehicle, and both the responding officer and the statements taken at the scene
confirm that Passenger's presence. Officers observed that the damage to both vehicles is generally consistent with
the described impact sequence, with the most significant deformation located on the driver-side door and quarter
panel of the struck vehicle. The shoulder complaint is consistent with the mechanics of a side impact of this type.
Photographs taken at the scene confirm several of the reported details, though no independent witnesses were
identified. Officers found no indication of prior damage to the vehicle in the area of impact. Driver 1 is listed as a
named insured on the policy covering the vehicle involved.
